text:
High-Risk Pregnancy Copilot for Frontline Workers
An AI assistant helping health workers detect and manage high-risk pregnancies across India

Current Status: Deployed with 3000+ ANMs across Uttar Pradesh, Telangana and Maharashtra. 12000+ ANMs by march 2026.

Reaching: 400,000 pregnant women annually

Recognition

Winner of the Global Grand Challenges for Equitable AI 2023 by the Gates Foundation.  (1500 applicants, 50 winners)

Notably, this project was featured amongst the 5 coolest innovations from across the globe by Mr. Bill Gates himself.

Winner of Google.org accelerator 2025 (3000 applicants, 20 winners)

Jump to:

Problem

Solution & Key Features

Results & Impact

Team & Partners

Solution

A multilingual, voice-enabled AI assistant delivered through WhatsApp that provides instant, expert-verified clinical guidance.

Why it works:

Instant answers to clinical questions, anytime

Works in local languages (Hindi, Telugu, Marathi) via text or voice

No new apps – uses WhatsApp ANMs already have

Expert-verified protocols for 35 high-risk conditions

Human backup for complex cases

Problem

One woman dies in childbirth every 20 minutes in India. Over 26,000 women die annually from preventable pregnancy complications. India’s 150,000 ANMs struggle with:

Limited access to medical knowledge during remote home visits

Responses to questions on take 24-48 hours

Training that fades within 30-60 days

Overburdened with multiple digital systems

Inadequate support for complex cases

View fullsize

Queries to MTOs on whatsapp take 24-48 hours

View fullsize

Instant responses with escalations to MTOs

How it works

ANMs send questions via WhatsApp (text or voice) → Copilot provides instant guidance based on validated protocols → Complex cases escalate to medical experts → Continuous learning through follow-up questions.

Key Features

Clinically grounded: Built on ARMMAN's expert-verified protocols approved by health ministries and aligned with WHO/ICMR standards

Culturally sensitive: Provides locally relevant advice (e.g., vegetarian nutrition for anemic patients, accessible tests vs. expensive CT scans)

Safe & reliable: Human-in-the-loop escalation for uncertain cases; only ~20% of queries need expert review

Fast: 8-10 second response time

Scalable: Cost per query ~ Rs. 1.25  achieved with a mixture of product thinking and pipeline optimization

Results & Impact
Health Outcomes

ANMs report improved risk detection, better protocol adherence, more appropriate referrals, and higher quality documentation.

Adoption & Engagement

70% active usage in UP generating 20,000+ queries

80% adoption in Telangana

3x higher engagement vs. app-only learning

98% positive feedback from ANMs

Performance & utility

97% accuracy rated by medical experts

95%+ accuracy on evaluation sets

Only ~20% escalation rate (down from 60%)

Efficiency Gains

60% reduction in training officer workload

70% faster: 8-10 seconds (from 25-30s)

76% cost reduction: ₹1.20 per query (from ₹5)
